julesThoughtProcess: Chose an electric blue (#00C3FF) to evoke the spark of arc-welders and the glow of tech in a bustling, resilient community space, matching the grounded optimism prompt.
storyPanel: The hum of the neighborhood hover-skiff repair shop is a familiar comfort. Sparks fly as a modified loader-bot hands a wrench to its human owner, their greasy hands brushing. Times are tight, and parts are always scarce, but here among the smell of ozone and old coffee, there's an unspoken bond. They fix what's broken, together.
